files.README.txt:
UKIYO-E GALLERY

An independent OrbitUI pack: 27 public-domain museum prints, original frames,
one washi wallpaper and one hinoki-style shelf material. Not the Ko-fi pack.

Automatic OrbitUI installation only adds files. It does not activate a theme
or replace your wallpaper, shelf material, colours, or ornament preferences.

Use Wallpaper, ornaments and colours > Ornament collection > Ukiyo-e Gallery
to enable or disable individual prints. Tap a print on the shelf to zoom and
read its information card. Long-press to adjust the native placement controls.

Shelf theme > Ukiyo-e Gallery selects the full theme. Native theme selection
uses this pack's ornaments instead of other packs. If you want to keep author
busts and Japan ornaments mixed in, choose the wallpaper and Hinoki plank
separately instead of selecting the complete Shelf theme.

Ordinary frames follow OrbitUI's one-decoration-per-row and session shuffle
rules; author busts keep their matching priority. No runtime museum downloads.

Manual installation: extract the entire "Ukiyo-e Gallery" folder into
koreader/settings/bookshelf/ornaments/. Keep its theme/ subfolder intact.
Do not rename it to Halloween. OrbitUI with Bookshelf 5.3+ is required for
theme selection and tap-to-zoom information cards.

Source records, CC0 evidence and SHA-256 checksums: provenance.json.
Museum credits and independent-work notice: ATTRIBUTION.txt.
Only the two material textures are AI-generated, not the historic prints.
Generated material prompts: texture-prompts.json.
